{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm revenue is string with commas
# Check if any revenue strings contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Convert revenue to float after cleaning commas
# Also, we already know no rows have 999999.99, so we don't need to filter for that
# But we will filter for status == 'completed'

# Clean revenue: remove commas, convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
